images.scene: Robinson stands on the grassy bank of a small freshwater brook winding through smooth open savannahs, bending to examine tall green tobacco plants growing on the rising ground beside him.
images.alt: A man examines tall tobacco plants on the grassy bank of a small brook.

images.scene: Night scene: Robinson has climbed high into the fork of a large tree and lies wedged among the branches asleep, his gun beside him, the dark valley and ridges of hills stretching below.
images.alt: A man sleeps high in the branches of a tree at night above a dark valley.

images.scene: Wide panorama of a lush green valley opening to the west, everything in fresh spring verdure like a planted garden, with a little spring of water issuing from the hillside; Robinson stands small on the slope surveying it.
images.alt: A man on a hillside looks out over a lush green valley like a garden.

images.scene: Robinson reaches up to hang heavy clusters of grapes over the outer branches of the trees to cure and dry in the sun, a bundle of gathered limes and lemons on the ground at his feet.
images.alt: A man hangs bunches of grapes on tree branches to dry in the sun.

images.scene: Inside the cave habitation, Robinson looks down in surprise at his cat that has returned home, now sitting with three small kittens gathered around her on the ground.
images.alt: A man looks at a cat sitting with three kittens inside a cave.

images.scene: Robinson kneels and prostrates himself humbly on the ground outside his cave at dusk beside his notched wooden post, hands clasped in solemn prayer on the anniversary of his landing.
images.alt: A man kneels in prayer on the ground beside a notched wooden post at dusk.
